timer.erro.semPermissao: You don't have permission to log work on this item. Your time is still running — ask a project admin, then press Stop again.
timer.erro.itemSumiu: This work item no longer exists in Jira, so there is nowhere to log to. Your time is still here — use Discard if you no longer need it.
timer.erro.jiraFora: Jira didn't respond. Your time is safe and still running — press Stop again in a moment.
timer.erro.limite: Jira is rate limiting the request. Your time is safe — press Stop again in a minute.
timer.erro.rede: The request didn't complete. Your time is safe — press Stop again; Nativelog checks for a duplicate before writing anything.
timer.erro.recusado: Jira rejected the entry. Your time is still running — please report this.
timer.erro.corrompido: That timer's stored start time could not be read, so nothing was logged.
timer.erro.semItem: Nativelog could not tell which work item this is.
timer.erro.semUsuario: Nativelog could not identify you. Try reloading the page.
timer.erro.confirmar: This timer has been running a long time. Check the total before logging it.
timer.erro.generico: Something went wrong. Your time is still running — try again.
apontamento.erro.duracao: Enter a duration like 1h 30m, 45m, or 2 (meaning two hours).
apontamento.erro.curto: Jira works in minutes, so an entry has to be at least one minute long.
apontamento.erro.longo: A single entry can't be longer than 24 hours. Split it across the days the work actually happened.
apontamento.erro.futuro: That start time is in the future. Nativelog logs work that happened, so pick a time that has already passed.
apontamento.erro.inicio: Pick a valid date and time for when the work started.
apontamento.erro.deOutro: That entry belongs to someone else. Nativelog only edits and deletes your own — change it from Jira's work log tab if you have permission.
apontamento.erro.sumiu: That entry no longer exists in Jira. Someone may have deleted it already.
apontamento.erro.semEntrada: Nativelog lost track of which entry this was. Reload the panel and try again.
apontamento.erro.semPermissao: You don't have permission to log work on this item, so nothing was saved. Ask a project admin.
apontamento.erro.itemSumiu: This work item no longer exists in Jira, so nothing was saved.
apontamento.erro.jiraFora: Jira didn't respond, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
apontamento.erro.limite: Jira is rate limiting the request, so nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.
apontamento.erro.rede: The request didn't complete, so it may or may not have been saved. Check the list below before trying again.
apontamento.erro.recusado: Jira rejected the entry, so nothing was saved. Please report this.
apontamento.erro.generico: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.
semana.erro.janela: Nativelog could not work out which week to show. Reload the page.
semana.erro.busca: Jira rejected the search for your week. Please report this.
semana.erro.semPermissao: Your Jira permissions don't allow searching work items, so your week can't be built.
semana.erro.limite: Jira is rate limiting the request. Wait a minute and press Refresh.
semana.erro.jiraFora: Jira didn't respond. Nothing is lost — press Refresh in a moment.
semana.erro.rede: The request didn't complete. Press Refresh to try again.
semana.erro.semUsuario: Nativelog could not identify you. Try reloading the page.
semana.erro.generico: Your week couldn't be loaded. Press Refresh to try again.
worklog.jaGravado: Already logged: {0} to {1} as {2}. Nothing was written twice.
worklog.jaGravadoSemItem: Already logged: {0}. Nothing was written twice.
painel.semTimer: No timer running on this work item.
painel.curtoAnterior: Your previous timer ran for under a minute, so nothing was logged.
painel.curto: That timer ran for under a minute, so nothing was logged.
painel.outroItem.corpo: You have a timer running on {0} ({1}). Starting here logs that time to it first.
painel.preso.corpo: Your timer on {0} ({1}) could not be written to Jira. Until it is dealt with, no new timer can start.
painel.preso.corpoItemSumiu: Your timer on {0} ({1}) could not be written to Jira because that work item no longer exists. Until it is dealt with, no new timer can start.
painel.naoGravadoAinda.titulo: This time has not been logged yet
painel.naoGravadoAinda.corpo: {0} on {1} is still waiting to be written to Jira. Press Stop to try again.
painel.esquecido.titulo: This timer has been running a long time
painel.esquecido.corpo: Check the total before you log it.
painel.confirmarParada.titulo: Check this total before logging it
painel.confirmarParada.corpo: This timer has been running since {0}, which is {1}. Log that to {2}?
painel.semPermissao.titulo: You can't log work on this item
painel.semPermissao.corpo: Your Jira permissions on this project don't include logging work, so a timer here would have nowhere to go. Ask a project admin for the Work on issues permission.
painel.mudouPorFora: This timer is no longer running here — it was stopped, discarded or moved somewhere else. Check the work log for the entry.
painel.lista.titulo: Your time on this item: {0} in {1}
painel.lista.cortada: Showing the most recent entries only — this item has more than Nativelog lists here.
painel.jaApagado: That entry had already been deleted in Jira.
semana.somenteLeitura: Read-only. Nativelog shows you what Jira already lets you see, and never lets you change someone else's hours — do that from the work item's Work log tab if you have permission.
semana.cortada.titulo: This week is only partly shown
semana.cortada.corpo: You logged time on more work items than Nativelog reads in one go, so the total below is lower than your real week.
semana.cortadaTime.corpo: The team logged time on more work items than Nativelog reads in one go, so the total above is lower than the real week.
semana.falhas.titulo: Some items could not be read
semana.falhas.corpo: {0} could not be read just now, so any time on them is missing from this total.
semana.atrasoIndice: Time logged in the last few seconds can take a moment to appear here. Use Refresh if something you just logged is missing.
semana.timeVazio: Nobody logged time on this project during this week.
csv.nenhumProjeto: Every project is unticked, so there is nothing to export.
csv.instrucao: Select all of the box below and copy it, then paste into a spreadsheet or save it as a .csv file. Jira apps can't hand your browser a file directly.
semana.erro.precisaPro: The team view is part of the Pro edition. Everything about your own time stays available on every edition.
form.duracaoAjuda: Use Jira notation: 1h 30m, 45m, or 2 for two hours.
